workflow.class: public Yusa CRISPR screen guide counting and MAGeCK testing
workflow.dataset_scope: ERR376998 plasmid and ERR376999 ESC1 against the 87,437-guide Yusa library
workflow.private_data_handling: public ENA reads and public MAGeCK library only; no private data

library.name: MAGeCK Yusa library
library.revision: public demo library used with ERR376998 and ERR376999

dotmatch.command: dotmatch count --targets yusa_library.csv --reads ERR376998.fastq.gz --reads ERR376999.fastq.gz --sample-label plasmid,ESC1 --target-start 23 --target-length 19 --k 0 --metric hamming --format mageck --out dotmatch-0.6.1.counts.tsv --summary dotmatch-0.6.1.summary.json

comparator.name: MAGeCK count and test
comparator.command: mageck count -l yusa_library.csv -n escneg --sample-label plasmid,ESC1 --trim-5 23 --sgrna-len 19 --fastq ERR376998.fastq.gz ERR376999.fastq.gz

primary_endpoints.metric: sgRNA-keyed guide membership, gene strings, integer count cells, and mapped totals
primary_endpoints.expected: 87,437 guide rows and 174,874 count cells agree exactly after an identifier-keyed join
primary_endpoints.failure_criterion: any abnormal exit, partial output, missing or extra guide, gene mismatch, count mismatch, or mapped-total mismatch

primary_endpoints.metric: keyed sgRNA fields, non-rank gene statistics, and depleted/enriched FDR<=0.05 hit sets from MAGeCK test
primary_endpoints.expected: all keyed non-rank statistics and both FDR hit sets agree
primary_endpoints.failure_criterion: any identifier, sgRNA-field, non-rank gene-statistic, cross-tie rank, or FDR-hit-set difference

downstream_endpoint.command: mageck test -k COUNTS.tsv -t ESC1 -c plasmid -n yusa
downstream_endpoint.endpoint: keyed sgRNA and gene statistics plus depleted and enriched FDR<=0.05 hit sets

failure_criteria: stop before analysis if any input SHA-256 differs from the locked protocol
fail count equivalence on any guide, gene, count-cell, or mapped-total difference
fail downstream equivalence on any keyed non-rank statistic or FDR hit-set difference
report ordinal or top-N differences inside exact statistical ties without treating them as scientific disagreement
scope_limits: the evaluator owns protocol locking, execution, interpretation, and permission to publish
agreement would establish software-output reproducibility for this public workflow, not biological correctness
released DotMatch 0.6.1 performs the scientific run; any DotMatch 0.6.3 packet helper must be identified separately
this draft has not been sent and is not evidence of independent use or adoption
